title: ClearPath After-Hours Rate on TimeBank Remote Sessions
content:
**Remote ClearPath rate schedule (TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours).** The block hours of a weekday after-hours remote session for a client whose ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement is active at ClearPath Professional are multiplied by 0.9; those of one for a client whose ClearPath agreement is active at ClearPath Standard, ClearPath Essentials or ClearPath Monitor, by 0.95; those of any other remote session, by 1. ClearPath Premier and ClearPath Enterprise cover every hour of the week, so their sessions are never in the after-hours class.

| Session | Client's active ClearPath tier | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| weekday, after-hours class | ClearPath Professional | 0.9 |
| weekday, after-hours class | ClearPath Standard, Essentials or Monitor | 0.95 |
| weekday, after-hours class | no active ClearPath agreement | 1 |
| Saturday or Sunday, or weekday business-hours class | any | 1 |

Hypothetical case: a weekday after-hours session converting to 2.00 hours before this multiplier draws 1.80 hours for a ClearPath Professional client and 1.90 hours for a ClearPath Monitor client.
